# Deploying the rebuild

`dist/` is a complete static site. Every reference in it is page-relative, so it works from a domain root or from a
subfolder.

## Host configuration (generated by the build from `src/content/routes.json`)

**Apache.** `dist/.htaccess` does the following:
- serves `/404.html` for a missing path (`ErrorDocument 404 /404.html`);
- turns on `DirectorySlash`;
- turns off `MultiViews`;
- carries 15 `RedirectMatch 301` rules for the aliases and redirect chains the crawl observed (for example
  `/bundle/` → `/specials/` and `/home/` → `/`).

The case-variant rules (`/categories/CBD` → `/categories/cbd/`) live only here.

**Netlify and Cloudflare Pages.** `dist/_redirects` holds the same redirects in `<from> <to> <status>` form. It leaves
out the case-variant rules, which could loop on a host that matches case-insensitively.

**nginx** has no generated file. Write:
- `error_page 404 /404.html;`
- `try_files $uri $uri/ =404;`
- one `location = /from { return 301 /to/; }` per line of `_redirects`.

## Search engines

`dist/robots.txt` allows everything and points to `https://capecodcannabis.com/sitemap.xml`. That sitemap is
`dist/sitemap.xml`, with 6,542 URLs.

Every page's canonical and `og:url` point to `https://capecodcannabis.com/...`. Pages carry the source's own robots
meta (for example `index, follow`).

**Anywhere other than the live origin, the copy must not be indexed.** `tools/make-preview.mjs` makes such a copy: it
marks every page `noindex, nofollow` and adds `.nojekyll`.

## Preview on GitHub Pages

```sh
node tools/make-preview.mjs --out preview --prefix /<repo>    # copies dist/, noindex on every page, fails on any root-absolute reference
# push preview/ as the gh-pages branch of the repo; Pages serves it at https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/
node tools/noindex-live-check.mjs --base https://<user>.github.io/<repo>/ --delay 300   # paced check of the served copy
```

Pages caches files for 10 minutes. CSS, JS and images have fingerprinted names, so a republished page picks up its
new assets. A page already open in a browser needs Ctrl+F5.

## What depends on the live site

**The live menu.** The menu, the product prices and the pickup order are on the live WordPress / Joint Commerce menu.
Every "Shop Menu", "Check price and availability" and hand-off link carries `data-handoff="live-menu"` and points
to `https://capecodcannabis.com/...`. The Pickup bag here is a preview: "Place pre-order" is disabled, with its reason
shown.

**If WordPress is retired,** the menu needs a new home first, and the hand-off links must be pointed at it.

## Not wired: decide before go-live

**Forms.** There are three:
- the contact form (`/contact-cape-cod-cannabis/`);
- the application form (`/join-our-team-cape-cod-cannabis/`);
- the review form (`/moodi-day-review-portal/`).

Each renders its fields, labels and validation copy verbatim. Each also:
- uses `method="post"`;
- starts disabled;
- carries `data-sr-unwired="1"`;
- has its submission stopped by JS (BUILD-CONTRACT section 3, item 6).

Connect them to a form backend, and remove the attribute, before go-live.

**Newsletter signup is not one of them.** The footer's "JOIN OUR NEWSLETTER" opens `/join-our-newsletter/`, which
embeds the client's Alpine IQ signup form (`lab.alpineiq.com`) as an iframe, as the live site does. It works wherever
that service accepts the embedding page.

**Search** is client-side. It is a fingerprinted JSON index (`assets/search-index.<hash>.json`, 6,594 items) loaded
on first use, so it needs no server.

**The age gate** is client-side. Its storage key is `ccc-age-21`. It fails closed without JavaScript (BUILD-CONTRACT
4.17.1): the gate stays up, and its no-JS "Yes" link reveals the page for that view. Massachusetts requires age
verification on the website (935 CMR 500.105(4)).

## Before go-live

1. Settle the operator decisions:
   - A1: allowlist or authorization, so that the 5,856 product pages can carry real data (Plan A);
   - A4: whether the product stubs are indexed.
2. Settle the client decisions B1 to B22 (`docs/OPEN-DECISIONS.md`). These include the new disclosure copy (B21),
   which needs client and counsel review.
3. Wire the three forms.
4. Keep the live menu reachable.
5. Re-run the checks listed in `docs/README.md` on the final build.
6. Serve over HTTPS at `https://capecodcannabis.com/`, with no `noindex` (only preview copies carry it).
